create.name: Thomas Hübl
create.bio:
Thomas Hübl is an Austrian-born teacher of meditation and contemporary mysticism, and an author. He studied medicine in Vienna and worked for years as a paramedic before leaving his studies in the 1990s to devote himself to contemplative practice and teaching. From the early 2000s he led retreats in Austria and Germany, where participants began to bring up wounds handed down from the Second World War, and out of that work he developed a group process for meeting personal, ancestral and collective trauma with presence and clear communication. He later completed a doctorate on the subject.

His teaching joins the insights of mystical traditions with relational practice: meditation, attunement to others, what he calls transparent communication, and inquiry into how the past lives on in the present. He teaches mainly through online courses, which he has offered since 2013, a two-year Timeless Wisdom Training with in-person retreats in Europe and the United States, and a weekly podcast, Point of Relation. With his wife, the artist Yehudit Sasportas, he founded the Pocket Project, a nonprofit working on collective trauma. His books include Healing Collective Trauma, Attuned and Releasing Our Burdens, written with Richard Schwartz.

courses.title: Timeless Wisdom Training
courses.description: A two-year programme led by Thomas with week-long in-person retreats and online retreats, run through European and US groups. It centres on contemplative practice, group process and working with personal and inherited trauma, and is open to anyone committed to their own growth; entry is by application.

courses.title: The Art of Attunement
courses.description: A self-paced course of seven recorded modules with teachings, meditations and attunement practices for becoming more present with others and more aware of the relational field.

courses.title: Living Meditation: Embodying the Sacred
courses.description: A self-paced meditation course in six modules in which Thomas gives instruction and guided practices for deepening meditation on the cushion and carrying it into daily life, for beginners and experienced meditators.

courses.title: The Mystic's Guide to Transforming Stress
courses.description: Four recorded modules that look at stress as a message and teach practices of inner hygiene for restoring energy and deepening awareness.

courses.title: Navigating the Levels of Trauma Healing
courses.description: A six-module recorded course on meeting collective crises with presence, including practices for steadying overwhelm and anxiety in times of rapid change, with guest speakers and bonus material.

courses.title: The Ecosystem of Healing
courses.description: Five recorded modules plus a bonus module of teachings, meditations and practices that treat healing as a many-layered process reaching across every part of life.

free_resources.title: Living Meditation free video series
free_resources.description: A free three-part video series from Thomas introducing his approach to meditation as a living practice.

free_resources.title: The Mystic's Guide free video series
free_resources.description: A free five-part video series on working with stress through contemplative awareness.
